meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How AZAFCO International uses the details you send us and the data from Google Analytics, Vercel Web Analytics, Microsoft Clarity and Google Maps.

title: Privacy policy
intro: What information we receive when you visit this website or contact us, why we use it and what you can ask us to do.

who.title: Who we are
who.text: This website is run by {legalName} (AZAFCO International), an Egyptian company, commercial register no. {register}. Main office: {address}.

contact.title: When you contact us
contact.text: If you email us, message us on WhatsApp or call us, we receive the details you choose to share: usually your name, company, job title, email address, phone number, country and your requirements.
items: This website has no enquiry form. It can prepare an email or WhatsApp message for you, and nothing is sent until you send it yourself from your own email app or WhatsApp.
We use these details to answer your enquiry, to handle any order that follows and to keep a record of our business correspondence.
WhatsApp messages are handled by WhatsApp (Meta) under its own terms and privacy policy.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: We use these tools to understand how the site is used, for example which pages are visited and which contact buttons are clicked, and to improve the site.

items.name: Google Analytics 4 (Google)
items.text: Sets cookies to recognise a returning browser. Records the pages you view, clicks on the email, WhatsApp and phone buttons, your approximate location, device and browser and the site that referred you.

items.name: Vercel Web Analytics (Vercel)
items.text: Counts page views and visits without using cookies.

items.name: Microsoft Clarity (Microsoft)
items.text: Records how pages are used, such as clicks, scrolling and mouse movement, and shows them to us as heatmaps and session replays. It uses cookies.

analytics.note: These providers may process data on servers outside your country.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.text: The website is hosted by Vercel. Like any web server, it processes your IP address and basic request data to deliver the pages.

maps.title: Maps and links to other services
maps.text: The contact page shows maps from Google Maps. When a map loads, Google receives your IP address and may set cookies under its own policy. Links to WhatsApp and Google Maps open those services, and their own privacy policies apply.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: The site sets one cookie of its own (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your language. Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity run only if you accept them in the cookie banner; you can change your choice at any time with "Cookie settings" at the bottom of every page. Google Maps may set its own cookies when a map loads. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings; the site still works without them.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.text: We do not sell your personal data or share it with third parties for their marketing. The providers named on this page process data to run the services described here.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.text: You can ask us what personal details we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete them. Write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: We update this page when the way we use data changes. The date at the top shows the last update.
